interface.adapterScope: one adapter per prototype; admit/project dispatched per effect instance and per path; prototype status is a default only; unknown prototype rejected

output.directFacts: DirectFactRowV1[] evaluable fact rows: schemaVersion, factType, key, sourceActionId, sourceActorId, sourceEffectId, targetIds, amount, unit, durationTurns; declared magnitudes only, no mitigation/hit final settlement; column-code strings are not contributions
output.legalityModifiers: target-legality modifiers derived from current public state only (taunt source constraint, control cancellation, disarm or silence rules, state migration and erasure of taunt or control); forced taunt target set is sorted UTF-16 ascending; unique-target mechanisms with more than one taunter reject AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET
output.opportunityModifiers: opportunity identity and distribution modifiers (judgment rates, interference rates, resource locks) that enter candidate dependency tokens; declared magnitudes; mechanicMetadata holds per-effect-instance projection metadata (sourceEffectId plus prototype-allowed Chinese field-name keys 生效方式/结算标签/抗性类型/驱动属性/影响方向/对应等级) as verbatim normalized deep clones that are deep-frozen and never used for scoring/weighting
output.scheduledFacts: S5 scheduled and window facts (delayed triggers, duration adjustments, follow-up or summon window grants); 机制授予 carries triggerKey, maxActions and payload DirectFactRowV1 rows; triggerKey enum 主动触发/随下次行动触发 only; maxActions comes only from explicit 可用次数 (主动触发), missing 可用次数 rejects MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, 随下次行动触发 projects no maxActions; SUMMON_WINDOW carries durationTurns/strength; window adjust keys window.adjustTurns/window.settlementRatio
output.unsupportedOutcomeKinds: outcome kinds this adapter cannot project; non-empty only together with deferCode or an explicit reason code
output.deferCode: per-path defer code; empty string when the path is fully supported

project.candidateRetention: deferred candidates retain vector coverage and candidateAudit reason

effectSource.meaning: optional provenance marker for the effect position; ITEM_USE_EFFECT marks an effect unpacked from an item 使用效果 container; absent defaults to CANDIDATE_DECLARATION; never used for scoring

pendingProjection.policy: condition branches, trigger limits, 变身期间 duration and unsigned percent magnitudes that the adapter cannot adjudicate from public immediate input produce explicit pending entries in unsupportedOutcomeKinds with retainedInCandidateAudit true and no unconditional facts; pending is not INVALID_OPTION_VALUE: mechanically valid input is never disguised as mechanical illegality

constraints: whole-prototype hard exclusion is forbidden; every prototype keeps at least path-level support or explicit defer
silent zero for unrepresentable mechanics is forbidden; every zero contribution carries a reason code
future-route enumeration, world clone, result enumeration and hidden-state reads are forbidden in admit/project and legalityContext
deferred candidates retain vector coverage and candidateAudit reason; prototype-level defaultDeferCode is a default only and is liftable per path
taunt and interference form legalityContext before candidate freeze; PLAYER_LOCKED passes the same gate
all 621 in-battle paths are covered as supported or deferred; zero silent omission

revision 4 directFacts supersede factColumns: every SUPPORTED effect projection must have at least one non-empty of directFacts/legalityModifiers/opportunityModifiers/scheduledFacts, otherwise unsupportedOutcomeKinds with an explicit reason code; column-name-only projection is forbidden; same-effect multi-values are separate rows with distinct frozen keys (damage.power/damage.segments/damage.penetration/damage.type, state.primary/state.secondary, window.adjustTurns/window.settlementRatio); row uniqueness is (sourceEffectId, key)

revision 4 whitelists and numeric forms: per-prototype field whitelists are rev4Spec.fieldWhitelists (live registry allowed fields unioned with actual fields of the A+B formal library union, 3057 classified effects; source B adds zero whitelist-new fields); 数值 is a percent string or a finite number (signed percent => PERCENT, unsigned percent => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION, number => ABS, plain numeric strings rejected INVALID_OPTION_VALUE); 防御穿透 is a finite number or percent string (both PERCENT); 持续回合 is a nonnegative integer or 变身期间 (变身期间 => PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION, no fabricated turns); fields not in the whitelist (e.g. 延迟回合/打断效果) are rejected; 对应等级 is a finite number only and generates no default when absent

机制授予 scheduled fact carries triggerKey, maxActions and payload DirectFactRowV1 rows projected recursively from 授予效果; triggerKey follows the registry enum 主动触发/随下次行动触发 only (死亡时触发 is INVALID_OPTION_VALUE); maxActions comes only from explicit 可用次数 on 主动触发, missing 可用次数 rejects MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD (no default 1), 随下次行动触发 forbids 可用次数 per runtime and projects no maxActions; unprojectable nested payload defers or marks unsupported with reason; bare creation carriers (empty/missing 授予效果, or 召唤生成 without summon identity 召唤单位类型/召唤物名称) are UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK and the caller unpacks and uses the contained effects

multi-taunt: the full forced taunt target set sorted by UTF-16 code unit ascending forms the legal target set; when the mechanism requires a unique taunt target and more than one exists, reject AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET

DirectFactRowV1 amount must be finite (JSON schema plus runtime validator); targetIds must be actual candidate target ids; empty or symbolic placeholders are rejected; all IDs (sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId/targetIds) are non-empty, at most 512 characters, allow CJK/hyphen/space and reject C0 control characters and DEL

source and target context is required: sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId/candidateTargetIds missing in legalityContext reject admit with MISSING_SOURCE_CONTEXT or MISSING_TARGET_CONTEXT; explicit unsupported otherwise

target resolution: effect 目标 自身 resolves to [sourceActorId]; 单体/群体/全场/召唤物/目标 and 分身 (for prototypes whose registry allows 分身) resolve to candidateTargetIds; Provider/adapter must not re-enumerate the candidate set; unknown target value rejects INVALID_OPTION_VALUE

numericForms.数值: signed or unsigned percent string or finite number; signed percent => PERCENT with sign, unsigned percent => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION (direction uninferable), number => ABS; plain numeric strings without unit rejected INVALID_OPTION_VALUE
numericForms.防御穿透: finite number or percent string; both normalize to PERCENT
numericForms.持续回合: nonnegative integer or 变身期间; integer => TURNS, 变身期间 => PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION, no fabricated turn count

pendingProjection.policy: explicit pending in unsupportedOutcomeKinds with retainedInCandidateAudit; no unconditional facts; never INVALID_OPTION_VALUE for mechanically valid input

mechanicMetadata.valuePolicy: values are verbatim normalized deep clones of the effect field values, deep-frozen; consumers must not mutate or weight them
